messages.author: a29b76a7fee2ac43
messages.subject: EFA/CFA on different ordinal values
parts:
Hi all,

Can I use lavaan to perform EFA / CFA on a mix of 5-point and 7-point items together? e.g. like a partial credit model in the IRT world.

Thanks.

messages.author: 38226bd700051927
messages.subject: Re: EFA/CFA on different ordinal values
parts: Are they ordered categories, i.e. a Likert scale? If so, you can just use CFA or EFA. You only need to make sure the variables are specififed as type 'ordered' in the dataset, or using the  'ordered' argument to the 'lavaan()'/'cfa()' function.
